name: AvatarGroup
description: An overlapping stack of initials avatars with deterministic per-name gradients that cascade in, lift on hover and fan apart when the group is hovered or focused. Extra people collapse into an accent +N chip that expands the full list, with optional presence dots and name tooltips.
a11yNotes: The root is a role="group" with an aria-label; each avatar is a focusable role="img" whose aria-label includes the name and presence status (initials, dot and tooltip are aria-hidden). The +N chip is a native button with aria-expanded and an aria-label listing the hidden names. Focus shows the tooltip and spreads the stack; under prefers-reduced-motion the entrance, lift, spread and status ping are disabled.

propsApi.name: names
propsApi.description: People in the stack; initials and gradient are derived deterministically from each name.

propsApi.name: max
propsApi.description: Maximum avatars shown before the rest collapse into a +N chip.

propsApi.name: overlap
propsApi.description: Overlap between neighbours as a fraction of the avatar size (0-0.6).

propsApi.name: spreadOnHover
propsApi.description: Fan the avatars apart while the group is hovered or focused.

propsApi.name: showStatus
propsApi.description: Show a deterministic presence dot (online pings softly).

propsApi.name: showTooltip
propsApi.description: Show the full name in a tooltip on hover or focus.

propsApi.name: onExpandedChange
propsApi.description: Called when the +N chip expands or collapses the full list.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
